description: This file defines an asynchronous utility function 'importFreshModule' that dynamically imports a module given a base URL and a specifier, returning the imported module cast to a generic type. It is used for importing modules in a way that emulates cache-busting or fresh imports, potentially for testing or code-split scenarios.

methods.name: export async function importFreshModule<TModule>( importFreshModule
methods.description: Asynchronously imports a module using a constructed URL from a base URL and specifier, returning the module cast to a generic type.
